title: Demo Air policy: meal allowance
excerpt: 15 EUR paid at once when the care trigger is reached. Further meals are reimbursed by receipt, at most 60 EUR per 24 hours of waiting in total, the 15 EUR included.
summary: Meal allowance set by Demo Air policy, paid as care under Article 9(1)(a): a flat amount at once, then receipts up to a daily total.
